svg.title: Flask Movie Graph App Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing data flow from IMDB/MovieLens datasets through ingestion scripts into Neo4j, accessed by a Flask API layer, rendered by Jinja2 templates in the browser.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I download the IMDB dataset?')
sendPrompt('How do I download the MovieLens dataset?')
sendPrompt('Write a Python ingestion script for Neo4j from IMDB and MovieLens data')
sendPrompt('Show me example Cypher queries for a movie graph database')
sendPrompt('What Flask routes should I create for a movie graph app?')
sendPrompt('How do I connect Flask to Neo4j using the Python driver?')
sendPrompt('What graph algorithms make sense for a movie database? e.g. shortest path, PageRank')
sendPrompt('What Jinja2 templates do I need for a movie graph Flask app?')
sendPrompt('How do I visualize a Neo4j graph in a Flask app using Neovis.js or D3?')
sendPrompt('How do I build a search box in Flask that queries Neo4j full-text search?')
sendPrompt('What does the final Flask movie app look like in the browser?')
g.text: Browser — renders movie pages, actor graphs, search results
